description:
Price a skin loadout: 7 clothing slots and 6 hotbar slots. The loadout builder (https://rust.wiki/loadout): every slot's skin with its price (USD cents, the wiki's Steam
price: lowest listing, else highest buy order) and the `total_price`; `unpriced` counts skins with no price and
`unknown` itemdefids that matched no skin. `page` opens the same loadout. Find itemdefids with /skins/search; to
check that the clothing can be worn together and see it in 3D, use /skin-lab/outfit. Find skin itemdefids with search_skins first. For wear-rule checks and a 3D view use skinlab_build_outfit.

clothing.description: Up to 7 comma-separated skin itemdefids worn (any clothing or armour skins).

hotbar.description: Up to 6 comma-separated skin itemdefids on the hotbar (weapons, tools, anything).
